```{r}
#| label: setup
scratch_file <- if (file.exists(".heather_scratch_objects.rds")) {
  ".heather_scratch_objects.rds"
} else {
  "ons/.heather_scratch_objects.rds"
}
scratch <- if (file.exists(scratch_file)) readRDS(scratch_file) else NULL
```

# Patient Flows

## ICB of residence to ICB of birth

```{r}
#| label: patient-flow-icb
#| fig-alt: "Sankey of records from ICB of residence to ICB of birth."
#| out-width: "100%"
if (!is.null(scratch)) scratch$icb_sankey
```

## Booking trust to birth trust

```{r}
#| label: patient-flow-trust
#| fig-alt: "Sankey of records from booking trust to birth trust."

if (!is.null(scratch)) scratch$trust_sankey
```

